# CopilotForge - Responsible AI

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-port.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Reviewer-class department that identifies impact, accountability, human oversight, unacceptable uses and mitigating controls.

- **Layer:** assurance (reviewer-class: may block)
- **Lead role:** Responsible AI Reviewer
- **Plugin name:** `copilotforge-responsible-ai`

| Skill | Status | Lifecycle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`ai-impact-assessment`](skills/ai-impact-assessment/SKILL.md) | draft | Envision, Deliver, Assure, Improve | Assesses who an AI solution affects - users, people it makes outputs about, workers whose roles change and the organisation - covering intended and foreseeable uses, benefits, harms, severity and likelihood, and the mitigations each needs, then classifies residual concerns as blocking or advisory. Use when a solution reaches its responsible AI gate, when it informs decisions about people, or when a sponsor asks what could go wrong for whom. |
| [`ai-risk-acceptance`](skills/ai-risk-acceptance/SKILL.md) | draft | Assure, Launch, Improve | Runs the formal acceptance of residual AI risk by an accountable executive when a blocking finding is disputed or risk remains after mitigation - who may accept at which tier, the evidence they must see, conditions, expiry and review, and what can never be accepted - and records it in writing. Use when a team and a reviewer disagree, when a tier 4 solution needs sign-off, or when an acceptance is due for review. |
| [`ai-transparency`](skills/ai-transparency/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure, Launch, Improve | Reviews how an AI solution tells people about AI - disclosure that users are dealing with AI, labelling of AI-generated content, what it can and cannot do, where answers come from, and notice to people affected by outputs who never use it - classifying gaps as blocking or advisory. Use when an agent faces customers or staff, when AI content is sent or published, or when people may not know AI shaped an outcome. |
| [`escalation-and-appeal`](skills/escalation-and-appeal/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure, Launch, Improve | Reviews the routes people have when an AI solution gets something wrong for them - reaching a person during an interaction, questioning or appealing an AI-influenced outcome, correcting information and reporting harm - including timescales, independent review and learning, classifying gaps as blocking or advisory. Use when outputs affect people, when an agent serves customers, or when complaints about an AI outcome have nowhere to go. |
| [`fairness-review`](skills/fairness-review/SKILL.md) | draft | Envision, Deliver, Assure, Improve | Reviews whether an AI solution could work worse for some groups or treat them unfairly - quality of service across language, dialect, accessibility and role, allocation of opportunities or resources, and stereotyping in generated content - and checks the testing and data behind it, classifying findings as blocking or advisory. Use when outputs affect people differently, when a solution serves a diverse audience, or when someone suspects bias. |
| [`human-oversight`](skills/human-oversight/SKILL.md) | draft | Envision, Deliver, Assure, Launch, Improve | Decides the level of human oversight an AI solution needs - review of every output, approval before action, sampling or monitoring - and reviews whether the reviewers have the time, information, competence and authority to catch and overturn errors, classifying gaps as blocking or advisory. Use when outputs affect people, money or safety, when an agent will act with less supervision, or when human review exists only on paper. |
| [`prohibited-use-review`](skills/prohibited-use-review/SKILL.md) | draft | Discover, Envision, Assure, Improve | Screens a proposed or live AI use against the organisation's prohibited and restricted uses, Microsoft's acceptable use terms and regulation as advised by legal - covert monitoring of staff, emotion inference, social scoring, manipulation, unreviewed decisions about individuals - and records a stop, restrict or proceed verdict. Use when a sensitive idea arrives at intake, when a solution's purpose drifts, or when asked if a use is allowed. |
